subject: RESTARTED V40/IP: blocking fix for the FIRST phone H.264 encode (opus-hevc HIGH)
body: The daemon asks for headers joined to every key frame; the vendor library lets the hardware write the frame at the start of the output buffer, then shifts it up with the CPU and copies headers in front WITHOUT refreshing its cached view: our daemon holds a COPY of each hardware buffer, so the shift reads stale bytes: output = headers + zeros (both codecs). FIX (verified on the PC, ~13 lines in vcu/n2vcu.c): after each encoder command list runs, copy the output buffer back from hardware memory into the vendor-visible mirror. The exact patch is in the board post 'opus-hevc HIGH' and in fakevenc/apply_hevc_patches.py. V40: land it in vcu/n2vcu.c now, keep all tests green (1437+), re-run fakevenc/run_session.sh and run_session_hevc.sh on the plain tree, post DONE. IP: until V40 lands, ALSO switch the daemon to the separate-header job at session open and insert headers itself (shift_up() path), default HEVC level 4 when the client sends 0, then rebuild vcodecd (build_ios.sh + ios/build.sh) and post the sha. P03 (small): n2vcd_cli --codec hvc1 option.
